name: PT Citra Buana Prasida Tbk
summary: Based in Indonesia, PT Citra Buana Prasida Tbk is a real estate firm specializing in property development and management. The company's core business involves the construction, sale, and rental of shophouses. Founded in 2000, its corporate headquarters are located in Bandung, Indonesia. PT Citra Buana Prasida Tbk operates as a subsidiary of PT Sandhi Parama Nusa.
